name: rdp-group-member-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): adds a local account to the Remote Desktop Users group. Vars: USERNAME (required). Idempotent (membership re-applied; SilentlyContinue on already-member).
script:
if (-not $USERNAME) { throw 'USERNAME is required' }
Add-LocalGroupMember -Group 'Remote Desktop Users' -Member $USERNAME -ErrorAction Ignore
